title: ChatActiveArtifactContext
description: Active artifact and element selection context captured by the UI. Phase 2 topology follow-up tools use this metadata without exposing it as natural-language prompt text.

artifactId.description: Chat artifact id currently active in the UI. If omitted, agents may resolve the latest applicable artifact from thread state.

kind.description: Artifact kind. Phase 2 acts only on topology artifacts.

title.description: Human-readable artifact title for clarification prompts and diagnostics.

surface.description: Artifact surface that was active when the message was submitted.

viewId.description: UI hint copied from the topology artifact binding. Services must validate against the loaded artifact.

scope.description: UI hint copied from the topology artifact binding. Services must validate against the loaded artifact.

selectedNodeIds.description: Stable topology graph node ids selected at submit time.

selectedEdgeIds.description: Stable topology graph edge ids selected at submit time.

activeLayerIds.description: Overlay layer ids currently selected or focused in the UI.

revision.description: UI's last observed topology overlay state revision.
